We couldn’t be prouder to be recognised among such renowned peers in the industry, and to be the first Design & Build practice to receive this title.
At Thirdway, we create offices you
to go to — spaces that bring out the best in people. We will continue doing exactly that, entering 2026 as Interior Design Practice of the Year.
